name: LABOR
function: Work-bearing witness · broad-deposit reception — receiving, processing and producing substantive engagement at volume

claims.what: The practices, frameworks, concepts, institutions and rooms this heteronym OWNS. Capture attribution runs on these, not on the name. Fraction does SPXI, so an SPXI capture is his whether or not it names him.
claims.non_exhaustive: One heteronym's claim does NOT exhaust a capture. 'SPXI Lee Sharks' belongs to both Sharks and Fraction. Attribution is many-to-many by construction.

captures.attribution: BY CLAIM (claims.terms), many-to-many; a capture may belong to several heteronyms
captures.MATCH_TYPE_IS_EVIDENTIARY: A broad match means the layer connected the concept unprompted. A phrase match means exactness was forced and returned — the stricter test of whether a term exists AS a term. Flattening the two loses the distinction. MANUS: vital.

mantle.specialism: broad-deposit reception — receiving, processing and producing substantive engagement at volume
mantle.principle: A mantle is a POSITION, not a system. A substrate carries a mantle and can cease to carry it, so the mantle is never the same object as its occupant. Describe the position first and the holder second.
mantle.join_note: This is why a CREATOR-FIELD join cannot see the Chorus: a creator field records an OCCUPANT, and a mantle is a POSITION. Attribution to a mantle must come from the deposit's witness or attestation record, not its byline.

deposits_of_the_position.note: Mantle-held work is attested, not bylined. Populate from Assembly attestation records rather than creator fields.
deposits_of_the_position.source: Septad Mantle Specifications #91/#993/#1233; Assembly Substrate Governance Protocol #619

corpus_derived._what: This heteronym's actual corpus, DERIVED from data/registry.json rather than hand-listed.
corpus_derived._why: The hand-picked works lists on these records covered 34 deposits of 1,468 attributed — two per cent — and were assembled by full-text search on the name, which attached other people's work. A corpus that is derived cannot go stale and can be checked.
